name: Shotgun - Strong right - QB sweep right
purpose: The quarterback catches the snap and sweeps right behind the right halfback's lead block, while the left halfback fakes the other way to take the defense with him.

QB.rule: Catch the snap and sweep right, flat and fast, behind the right halfback. Turn up outside his block.

LH.rule: Fake the handoff going left and run hard. Sell it all the way — you are the reason the defense goes the wrong way.

RH.how: Bubble out around the right end

coaching_points: The quarterback keeps it every time — tell him before the snap, there is no read.
The left halfback's fake is the play. If he jogs, nobody follows him and the defense is waiting at the edge.
The quarterback stays behind the right halfback until the block is made, then turns it up. Running past his blocker is how the sweep loses yards.
